P40_and_patterns.p40: SAME_CLASS — SourceInput vs DataFact; the six additions widen the fixture boundary as a whole rather than patching each old test separately.

authority_and_currentness.authentic_default: Separate production default path; exact vintage refusal is required before profile construction. It is not replaced by the successful synthetic read.
authority_and_currentness.handcrafted_profiles: Used only as controlled candidate fixtures; their fabricated refs/digests are not production evidence.
authority_and_currentness.original_five_tests: Remain unmodified and production-positive claims remain verification_missing; the patch adds new controlled cases and one negative, but contains no production-positive source receipt.
authority_and_currentness.synthetic_source: Reader-materialized profile from generated tmp_path bytes; selection_owner is legacy.default_l2_source; authenticity and currentness are explicitly not_established.

candidate.original_five_test_ast_segments: manifest reports identical; patch is appended after those tests and has no hunk modifying them

case_review.reason: Constructs a controlled contested edge with two explicit admissible completions, binds it into a profiled reference, checks candidate/unknown-authenticity/currentness, and asserts contested/set-valued/non-confirming behavior.

Uses the existing real synthetic source builder under tmp_path, consumes via _iter_l2_edges, extracts the reader-produced legacy-default profile, and proves an unknown key remains out_of_scope. Its removal subcase retains a profiled sibling and verifies the profile still resolves before asserting removed-key refusal.

Uses five explicit controlled edges, checks exact per-modality status/total counts, sum equals input length, and checks the four intended modalities are in the declared included scope. It makes no production-total claim.

Runs the actual causal/family derivation functions on controlled rows and compares against independently authored complete payload bodies, canonical JSON encode/decode, and typed reconstruction. The expected content digest uses the shared gy_content_hash protocol, so this test is not an independent implementation test of the hash primitive.

Binds a candidate controlled reference, changes one scoped edge, rebuilds hashes/epoch, and asserts stale status with epoch/hash/scoped-edge reasons and the exact stale key; authenticity/currentness remain not_established.

After constructing an explicitly candidate-only control profile, spies on the classmethod used by the current implementation, invokes the actual default build_credal_reference(REPO_ROOT), expects the typed vintage refusal, and verifies no production source-profile model_validate occurred. This is local source-data dependent and does not make the five production-positive cases pass.

residuals_and_limits: Author static checks report AST/Ruff/format/git-apply-check only. Native execution was not run by author or reviewer; root must run focused selected new tests against the composed current source.
The original five production-positive tests still share the production fixture and remain unverified at current production bytes; this companion does not suppress, skip or re-label their outcome.
The synthetic-source control covers the actual legacy default reader path, not a WMR-selected production release, serving instance, installed wheel, or browser surface.
The removal and certificate tests exercise reference semantics with controlled profiles; they do not establish actual production source or certificate history.
scope_limit: This is a static independent review of a virtual test-only patch. It does not mean tests passed, production positives are verified, or any formal closure is adjudicated.

validated_contract_points: The explicit synthetic SKG builder rejects records lacking synthetic=True plus a nonempty fixture_scope, requires an existing parent directory and rejects clobbering existing writer artifacts.

The synthetic default read goes through the existing SKGQuery source-byte/vintage boundary; unregistered digest is not a currentness claim, and the emitted CredalReferenceSourceProfile keeps candidate authority with authenticity/currentness not_established.

A profiled CredalReference requires every selected-source L2 edge to carry the same profile; the removal control retains edge-b and checks the profile resolver, so it does not create an empty-source profile-bearing K_ref.

Default build_credal_reference selects the composed production WMR, and _prepared_l2_source runs require_forwardable_confidence before prepared-read profile construction; the negative control calls that actual default path.
